pubsub_topic.description: The Pub/Sub topic to send notifications to. Its format is "projects/[project_id]/topics/[topic]".
pubsub_topic.security_impact: If the Pub/Sub topic is misconfigured or points to an unapproved destination, security notifications may be lost or exposed to unauthorized subscribers.
pubsub_topic.rationale: Notifications must be delivered to approved, secured Pub/Sub topics to maintain the integrity and confidentiality of security alerts.
pubsub_topic.compliant: Pub/Sub topic is correctly configured and points to an approved, secured topic within the organization.
pubsub_topic.non-compliant: Pub/Sub topic is missing, invalid, or points to an unapproved/unsecured destination.

streaming_config.description: The config for triggering streaming-based notifications. Structure is [documented below](#nested_streaming_config).
streaming_config.security_impact: Improper filters may cause critical findings to be missed or irrelevant alerts to be generated, reducing monitoring effectiveness.
streaming_config.rationale: Streaming configuration must include properly scoped filters to ensure only relevant findings generate alerts.
streaming_config.compliant: Streaming config includes a valid filter that correctly targets relevant findings or assets.
streaming_config.non-compliant: Streaming config is missing, invalid, or has overly broad/narrow filters leading to loss of visibility or noise.

organization.description: The organization whose Cloud Security Command Center the Notification Config lives in.

config_id.description: This must be unique within the organization.
config_id.security_impact: If config_id is not unique or poorly managed, it may overwrite or conflict with existing notification configurations, leading to loss of alerts.
config_id.rationale: Each notification config must have a unique identifier to ensure proper management and avoid conflicts within the organization.
config_id.compliant: Config_id is unique within the organization and follows naming conventions.
config_id.non-compliant: Config_id is missing, not unique, or conflicts with existing notification configurations.

description.description: The description of the notification config (max of 1024 characters).
